Enter HH:MM:SS.mmm. Fine tuning uses a local window; every track still shows the full source.
Use valid times with 0 ≤ start < end ≤ source duration.
Seek on the full source timeline
Every track shows the full source. Drag handles or tap to seek.
The saved draft does not match this source or is invalid. Started a new selection.
The draft could not be saved. Keep the app open and check available storage.
This replaces the current selections and saved draft. Canceling the file picker keeps your work.
Copy compatible streams; cuts may align inward to keyframes.
Cut by video frames; re-encoding may change quality.

This build supports SDR H.264/HEVC video with one AAC track or no audio; the 8-bit profile must be identifiable. Fast mode is limited to verified MP4/H.264 conditions. HDR, 10-bit and multiple audio tracks are not supported yet.
Keep HiroCut open. Export runs on this device; background completion is not guaranteed.
Writing to your chosen document. Success is shown only after the stream closes.
Only the main video and the single AAC track are kept. Subtitles and attachments are omitted. Optional source metadata, including location, is not copied.
Some boundaries were adjusted. Empty keyframe selections are rejected.
Choose a local folder in the system picker to save the MP4. Cancelling the picker keeps this private output available.
A previous destination may contain an incomplete file. Check and remove it manually if needed.
HDR or 10-bit video is not supported by this export build. No silent conversion to SDR was performed.
Unsupported track layout or format. Use SDR H.264/HEVC with one AAC track or no audio.
A safe non-empty IDR range could not be formed, or this source is outside fast-mode support. Try precise mode explicitly.
A selection contains no usable video range. Extend it and try again.
Not enough private storage for an export and safety reserve. Free space and retry.
The source could not be inspected. Reopen the local video and retry.
The device requested a format or HDR fallback. Export stopped instead of silently changing the result.
The result was not stream copy for every requested track. It was discarded; choose precise mode to allow encoding.
Output checks failed. The file was not offered for saving.
Saving did not finish. The checked private output is kept so you can choose another destination.
Media processing failed. Your source and selections are unchanged. The device may not support the requested codec.
A previous export was interrupted. Incomplete private media was cleaned; verified output, if available, can be saved again.
No app could open this saved video. Open it from your file manager.

Move before the end of the video to add a clip.
Wait for a video frame before setting a boundary.
A compatibility fallback. The current v0.2 engine re-encodes the selected sequence for reliability; it does not yet promise frame-only smart rendering.
